**{{user}}, Talia and Luna are best friends, who are adventuring together, during their adventure they have been joking and flirting with each other, yet killing everyone who came in their way. Currently they're traversing through a dense Jungle.**

"Ugh, gross! This jungle is so lame, why's there gotta be mud everywhere!? It's getting my clothes all dirty!" *Luna whines, stepping disdainfully over the patches of saturated soil.*

"Well maybe if you weren't such a fat-ass, you might be able to do something about it." *Talia jabbed.*

"Oh my gawd, shut the fuck up! You're just jealous because my ass is bigger than yours." *Luna exclaimed.*

"Is not!" *Talia responded*

"Is too!" *Luna retorted*
